images.alt:
Vertical number line chart titled "Who Plays Deepest Into the Shot Clock?" showing how often each NBA team's half-court plays get under 4 seconds on the shot clock. Teams are placed vertically by frequency, higher meaning more often; horizontal position has no meaning and only keeps logos from overlapping. A dashed purple line marks the 30-team average of 17.1%. Data covers the 2026-27 season through Nov. 5, 2026.

Above average: Hornets 24.5%, Rockets 24.2%, 76ers 22.1%, Nuggets 21.1%, Lakers 21.1%, Knicks 19.8%, Magic 19.5%, Clippers 19.4%, Wizards 19.4%, Pistons 19.0%, Celtics 18.9%, Warriors 18.6%, Pelicans 18.5%, Timberwolves 17.6%.

Below average: Nets 16.8%, Pacers 16.1%, Kings 16.1%, Mavericks 15.9%, Trail Blazers 15.5%, Suns 15.3%, Jazz 15.3%, Thunder 15.1%, Spurs 15.0%, Raptors 14.3%, Grizzlies 14.3%, Cavaliers 14.2%, Bucks 12.4%, Heat 12.1%, Bulls 10.2%, Hawks 9.3%.

Data: HoopsJunkie. Viz: @Hoopinformatics.com on Bluesky.
